title: oma's block outline
description: This texture pack adds colorful outline while breaking blocks
body:
## The outline grows and changes color from red to green as you break the block. When the circle is complete, the block is broken!

![stage 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d302c81eea6fb2d7589e0e26d28ae49388a7786.png)
![stage 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0517baa30d345f033c42d2cd28ed54e4421afe2b.png)
![stage 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4782123d8a9980dfdda5d4a62a0b6eb6dce7519e.png)
![stage 4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea170840e832088a4e469cf99fe40bbffbbfa3e8.png)
![stage 5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4fc4853012ec183fe3e9fb19b21b72a88dc9a30.png)
![stage 6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb9e7e3bf47aa03722b80d1d9b4b115063e8bf74.png)
![stage 7](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebd00caeebc08a92ca1c0792d3e0691e61203e90.png)
![stage 8](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f05ad776e3d5fe912ed00149ff24a0b10bd1c1c7.png)
![stage 9](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a43fb67f664521ddd2f8b75d12319414320a029.png)


### Features:

    Smooth color transition from red to green.

    Rotating animation while mining.

    Works on all blocks.

### Compatibility:

    Supports all versions from 1.18.2 to 1.21.4.

    No OptiFine required.
